description: the man of the reference picture riding: a primeval god of the hunt, light tan skin, light brown hair and a short light brown beard, a rugged face in clean profile, eyes glowing amber, the head of a giant white wolf worn as a hood with huge curved golden-brown aurochs horns rising from it, the white wolf pelt hanging down his back as a long fur mantle, armour of ivory bone and gold, a necklace of great fangs, a deep crimson sash and skirt, brown leather bracers, ivory greaves and brown boots, no bow, no wolves and nothing in the hands but the reins; sitting tall and upright astride a saddle that is not drawn, the back straight, not squatting and not crouching, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the head, chest and hips turned fully to the right; both forearms reaching forward, the two hands together in front of the body holding short reins that end just in front of the hands; only the near leg showing and only one foot in the whole picture: the thigh lying forward and level from the hip to the knee, the knee bent at a right angle, the lower leg hanging vertically straight down from the knee, one whole foot at the bottom with the toes pointing right; the cloak and any long hair hanging down behind the back, not spread out; the far leg completely hidden and not drawn at all, no second boot and no second foot; the whole figure from the tips of the horns to the sole of the foot inside the picture with room around it; nothing under the rider; isolated figure on a plain background

references.usage: the character's look: this same man, his face, hair, beard, wolf hood with the horns, fur mantle, armour and colours, drawn the same way; not his standing pose and not the bow and the spirit wolves
